title: Release docs: PROJECT.md, CHANGELOG and JSON stability
lead:
PROJECT.md still describes `dlog`, Python with unittest, and an unchosen
license. There is no CHANGELOG, and docs/json.md does not say what a 0.x
release promises about the JSON shapes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner chose to rewrite PROJECT.md to match what shipped (C165). A release
needs release notes and a stated compatibility promise.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `PROJECT.md`: rewrite it to match the shipped tool: the name adjudicate and `adj`, Go standard library, the license from C31 (GPL-3.0-or-later, Squalor LLC), the real command set and flags (including S26-S31), the v1 acceptance criteria as met, and the Later items as later. Keep its goals and non-goals in line with the catalog (C01-C13) and cite the owner decisions (C23-C33, C165-C169) where they changed the original brief.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (new): a `0.1.0 - <date>` entry listing the commands and the record format.
- `docs/json.md`: a short stability section: for 0.x, a shape may change in a minor release and the CHANGELOG names every change; 1.0 freezes it.
- `README.md`: the new flags and commands, the version, and a link to CHANGELOG.md.
- `internal/commands/ai.md`: the snippet covers `--ref`, `--recommend-text`, `--decided-at` and `amend`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None new. The test that checks `adj ai` output against `internal/commands/ai.md`, if one exists, still passes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Docs only; no code changes besides what keeps the ai snippet test green.
- Every command and flag named in the docs exists (`adj <command> --help`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- Every `adj ...` example in README.md and PROJECT.md is run once by the implementer against a temp store, and the output matches the docs.
- `grep -n -i -E 'dlog|python|unittest' PROJECT.md README.md` prints nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree `.worktrees/s32` on branch `s32`. Commit and land on local main when
the owner asks; no AI attribution.
